notes.title: 🚀 Enlightening Demo is Here! Try It Now!⚡
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

The Enlightening [b]demo[/b] is out NOW! 🎉

Get ready to push blocks, build circuits, and outsmart electrifying puzzles in this mind-bending logic game.

🔥 What’s in the demo?
✅ 15 handcrafted levels + 5 tutorials to get you started
✅ Unique energy-based mechanics that twist your brain in the best way
✅ A challenging yet rewarding puzzle experience

Think you’ve got what it takes to power up and escape? 😏

🔻 Try the demo now! 🔻
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3284120/Enlightening/

Thanks for being part of this journey! 🤖⚡
